hooks.statusMessage: Identifying you for the shared Hub folder...
hooks.command: $me=$env:USERNAME; $m='Shared Hub folder (one OneDrive folder, several machines). You are ' + $me + '. Git is allowed for ALL team members, but only ONE person at a time - coordinate in the team chat and check OneDrive shows synced before and after (.git/ is inside the synced tree). Rules: surgical edits only in knowledge/ (never whole-file rewrites); write only what you own; one Claude session on knowledge/ at a time; one NEW file per log entry in knowledge/_meta/log/; numbers live in knowledge/_status/ read via 01_status.md. Writes to the ontology, master workbooks, 03.extraction/, 01.SOMD/, ERA/data/, protocol/ and partners/ are denied by design - do not route around a refusal. Detail: knowledge/09_conventions.md section 13.'; Write-Output (@{systemMessage=$m;hookSpecificOutput=@{hookEventName='SessionStart';additionalContext=$m}}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress)

$in=[Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); if($in -match '(?i)"command"\s*:\s*"(?:[^"]*[^a-zA-Z0-9_])?git(\.exe)?[\s\\"]'){ $r='Git reminder: all team members may run git here, but only ONE person at a time - .git/ is inside the synced OneDrive tree, so confirm nobody else is running git right now and OneDrive shows synced before and after. See knowledge/09_conventions.md section 13.'; Write-Output (@{hookSpecificOutput=@{hookEventName='PreToolUse';additionalContext=$r}}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress) }
